scenes.headline: How LOTUS reasons in hidden states, not written tokens
scenes.sub: A looped padded Transformer, with each latent slot supervised by a gold step
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Zinnia! Chain of thought is slow because the model writes every step out, one token at a time. LOTUS thinks in hidden states instead.

scenes.text: Loop the same model over a fixed block of latent slots, refining them all at once, and ground every slot in a real reasoning token.
scenes.say: The idea: loop the same model over a fixed block of latent slots, refining them all at once. Then ground every slot in a real reasoning token.

steps.say: After the question, LOTUS pads in a latent region: six blocks of twenty-five learnable slots, a hundred and fifty positions.

steps.note: R passes for the whole trace, not one per token
steps.say: The same base model runs over every slot at once, adding its last output back in. Six passes for the whole trace, not one per token.
Each slot is then read through the ordinary LM head, and trained toward the gold chain-of-thought token that belongs there.
One more forward pass reads the finished latents and writes the answer, which gets its own loss.

scenes.title: Latents that decode to the gold token
scenes.note: top-1 readout of the post-loop latents
scenes.say: Both losses matter. Alone, each leaves latents that decode to the gold step nine point one or nine point four percent of the time. Together, seventy point nine.

scenes.title: Thought phase on Llama-3.2-3B, milliseconds
scenes.say: Six passes don't grow with the rationale, so thinking gets two point five to six point nine times faster, about a point and a half behind explicit accuracy.

scenes.text: The loop removes the sequential bottleneck; the supervision stops the drift. Together, latent reasoning keeps pace at 3B.

recap: Six blocks of latent slots, refined in parallel
The same weights, looped six times
Every slot supervised by a gold reasoning token
scenes.say: To recap: a fixed latent region, one model looped over it, and a gold token for every slot. A fixed budget, chosen in advance.
